learner text: 他的妈妈不想跟他的朋友去墓地，他们才一个星期住在那儿，孟子跟他的妈妈已经搬家了。
quote: 他的妈妈不想跟他的朋友去墓地
part p0: fix [ref p0/k0] 不想让他跟朋友去墓地 ; notes: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.

edits.original: 不想跟他的朋友去墓地
edits.corrected: 不想让他跟朋友去墓地
edits.note: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.
edits.reason: changes the mother from accompanying him to making him go
